coldStartupAndLostOsArtifacts.change: After recovery returns, MAIN reconciles due authorized work directly; system callbacks invalidate stale OS observations and rebuild artifacts without changing consent.
coldStartupAndLostOsArtifacts.regression: Lost OS artifact plus a unique worker explicitly deferred one day; one owned delivery after a direct reconciliation.

forceStopPrimarySignal.change: Use canonical launcher return; serialize listener ownership, explicitly remove the previous listener and arm the public current-start callback synchronously before the foreground first frame; callbacks and persistence remain on Core IO. No arbitrary historical PID=0 record or exit reason is accepted as proof.
forceStopPrimarySignal.proof: Fresh ApplicationStartInfo.wasForceStopped persisted after the real stopped boundary and before verification.

doze.change: Suspend only the test-derived alarm before idle entry, then re-register the original unchanged approval while deep idle remains active; real notification must be observed in IDLE before verification starts.
doze.proof: Actual private notification and one committed FIRED/SUCCEEDED occurrence in deep IDLE.

backgroundRestrictionCleanup.change: Preserve an absent AppOp's printed effective default (allow), which differs from explicit MODE_DEFAULT; restore and verify both AppOps and the original effective background restriction level.

deviceRepair.interpretation: MODE_DEFAULT (3) is not the absent operation whose printed default mode is allow (0). Restore the originally observed effective allow value; no exemption or whitelist.

reminderUiSynchronization.change: Assert the accepted title after text injection, keeping the enabled-button and exact-confirmation checks.

interruptedRepetition.interpretation: Unqualified UI attempt: no Compose hierarchy; device was previously observed asleep and locked, last sleep reason power_button. Preserve failure and require an unchanged rerun with the target awake/unlocked.

canonicalDocker.command: docker compose run --rm android-build check assembleDebug assembleRelease :app:assembleDebugAndroidTest :core:security:assembleDebugAndroidTest --max-workers=2

forceStopStress.scope: Read-only technical DataStore marker after actual process boundaries; production public primary API is the only writer
